sandbachFocus: Sandbach United suffered a narrow defeat in the FA Vase first qualifying round, losing to Ashby Ivanhoe. Despite an improved second-half display, the Bach couldn't find an equaliser and exited the cup competition. This came after their impressive 3-1 midweek victory at home to New Mills, where goals from Tetlow, Morris, and Page secured a strong performance.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals remained unbeaten with a 1-0 victory at Dawley Town (Kirton 66'), maintaining their position at the top despite dropping points in their last league fixture. AFC Bridgnorth bounced back impressively with a 4-1 home win over Crewe, with Zazi scoring twice in a dominant display, though they drew 1-1 at Wednesfield midweek. Shawbury United claimed another victory, beating Widnes Town 3-2 in an entertaining fixture. Eccleshall and Stafford Town both suffered FA Vase exits—Eccleshall won 4-0 against Allscott Heath before their midweek loss to Wolverhampton Casuals, while Stafford Town were beaten 3-0 by Abbey Hulton United on their 50th anniversary. New Mills lost their FA Vase tie 0-2 to Northwich Victoria after their league win over Sandbach. Foley Meir and Telford Town both progressed in the FA Vase via penalties, beating Redditch Borough and Darlaston Town respectively. Bilston Town secured a 3-0 away win at Brereton Social, while Barnton won 3-1 at Irlam in the Vase, and several other clubs exited early cup competitions.
